job_title: Remote Junior Java Developer - Full-Stack Entry-Level
job_description:
A government technology solutions provider is looking for an Entry-Level Java Developer for a 100% remote role on a federal government project. This position offers early-career developers a chance to work with experienced teams on full-stack applications, contributing to modernization and digital transformation initiatives. Candidates must have a bachelor's degree in a technical field and a solid understanding of programming concepts.

Benefits include medical, 401k match, PTO, and training opportunities.
